name: Tea Bowl: Jian ware
dimensions: Diameter: 12.8 cm (5 1/16 in.); Overall: 7 cm (2 3/4 in.)
summary: This tea bowl has rounded sides, a small foot, and a slight groove below the lip. The café au lait–colored glaze is burned thin at the rim. There are irregular blue-black "hare's fur" markings on the bottom of the bowl. The lip shows signs of much use.
